not_measurable: The two marks either side of the lettering are round blurred dots about 0.025 in across; the photograph does not resolve them as stars (the brief expected small stars), so they are modelled as dots

The plate and the lettering band are cast with a fine granular texture; drawn as flat tones. The thin light relief lines that run along the dark pales and the shield band are not drawn, except the 0.004 in light rim where the blades cross the pales
A small ogee notch in the shield point and the exact curvature of the lower sides are simplified to a smooth curve through eleven measured half-widths
The propeller blades are drawn as symmetric lenses from the hub centre at measured angles, lengths and widths; the slight twist of each blade is not resolved
The hang angle of the photograph (0.3 deg) is removed; the ring in the photograph is cut by the ribbon at its top, so its centre (0.0 in on the bail axis) and radius come from its visible lower half
fidelity.note: Redrawn as clean parametric vector (LIVE13-ART 26, batch B): every element is modelled as the object it is (letters, stars, wreath leaves, banner, aircraft ...) with its proportions measured from the photograph and placed by measurement; flat tones with a lit and a shadow edge; upright. Replaces the traced body (LIVE13-ART 20).

fit_score.note: IoU of the shipped upright miniature against the photograph mask in the same box (lib-b.js)
